cards.text: The city never logs off. Neither does the rain.
The Registry sees everyone. Every face, every door, every packet.
Almost everyone. No record, no face, one deck: you're a ghost.
Night ferry 7 leaves berth 4 with twelve boxes. The Port Authority cleared eleven.
The list is in seven pieces. The Registry knows who has it.
Plaza Central. The Spire. The list's lock is on its antenna.
